# Instructions for Claude

## Generated files

`src/tokens.json` is the source of truth. `dist/`, `docs/reference.md` and `demo/index.html` are
generated by `scripts/build.mjs`. Never hand-edit them: change the source or the build script, run
`npm run build`, then `npm test` (it fails if generated files are stale or a text colour drops below
4.5:1). Commit the source and the regenerated files together.

## Keep docs/ in sync

`docs/` holds the _why_, one file per area (tokens, theming, and later components). When a change
adds or alters how something works, update the matching `docs/*.md` in the same change. Use
concrete paths and real code, and flag footguns explicitly.

## Inline comments

Keep them short (about 5 lines at most): footguns ("change this and X breaks"), public API docs, or
a one-line pointer to `docs/<area>.md`. History and rationale go in `docs/`, not inline.

## Consumers

furioursus.dev (Astro + Tailwind v4), mtg-csv-sorter and mtg-library-value-tracker (static, no
build). Anything in `dist/` must keep working from a plain `<link>`/`<script>` with no bundler.
